properties.name: peach.captcha.cache-type
properties.description: Captcha cache type. 验证码缓存类型（MEMORY / REDIS 等）

properties.name: peach.captcha.service-type
properties.description: Captcha service type. 验证码服务类型

properties.name: peach.captcha.jigsaw
properties.description: Sliding jigsaw background image path. 滑动拼图底图路径

properties.name: peach.captcha.pic-click
properties.description: Picture click captcha background path. 点选文字验证码底图路径

properties.name: peach.captcha.rotate
properties.description: Rotate captcha background path. 旋转验证码底图路径

properties.name: peach.captcha.water-mark
properties.description: Watermark text shown on bottom-right. 右下角水印文字

properties.name: peach.captcha.water-font
properties.description: Watermark font file name. 水印字体文件

properties.name: peach.captcha.font-type
properties.description: Font type for click captcha. 点选文字验证码字体

properties.name: peach.captcha.slip-offset
properties.description: Allowed offset for slider captcha (pixels). 滑块验证码允许误差像素

properties.name: peach.captcha.aes-status
properties.description: Enable AES encryption for coordinates. 是否启用坐标 AES 加密

properties.name: peach.captcha.interference-options
properties.description: Interference level for slider captcha (0/1/2). 滑块干扰级别

properties.name: peach.captcha.cache-number
properties.description: Local cache max size. 本地缓存最大数量

properties.name: peach.captcha.timing-clear
properties.description: Local cache cleanup interval (seconds). 本地缓存清理周期（秒）

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-frequency-limit-enable
properties.description: Enable request frequency limit. 是否启用接口访问频率限制

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-get-lock-limit
properties.description: Max failed check attempts per minute. check 接口一分钟内失败次数

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-get-lock-seconds
properties.description: Lock duration after limit reached (seconds). 触发限制后的锁定时间

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-get-minute-limit
properties.description: Max get requests per minute. get 接口一分钟内最大访问数

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-check-minute-limit
properties.description: Max check requests per minute. check 接口一分钟内最大访问数

properties.name: peach.captcha.req-verify-minute-limit
properties.description: Max verify requests per minute. verify 接口一分钟内最大访问数

properties.name: peach.captcha.font-style
properties.description: Font style for click captcha (Font.BOLD etc). 点选验证码字体样式

properties.name: peach.captcha.font-size
properties.description: Font size for click captcha. 点选验证码字体大小

properties.name: peach.captcha.click-word-count
properties.description: Number of click words (not recommended currently). 点选文字个数（暂不建议使用）
